comments.author: @robert-nv1qn
comments.text:
Two things about this video bring this 82 year old native Western Washingtonian to tears. I recognize much of the scenery as I have traveled to much of the state. The beauty of the State brings me to tears.
But the other thing that bothers me is the horrible mispronunciation of so many of the names. If it is a human voice then he failed to educate himself. If it is AI they did not get what they paid for.
In either case it does not do our beautiful State justice. So Sad
